cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: It's time to have a little bit of fun because you've just been listening to me talking for a bit and we want to get our hands dirty and try this machine learning ourselves.
cues.zh: 聽我講了一陣子，現在來做點有趣的事，親手試試機器學習。

cues.en: But even though we don't know much about it yet, we can actually play with it.
cues.zh: 雖然還不太了解，其實已經可以操作。

cues.en: For example, there's a great website here by Google called Teachable Machine.
cues.zh: 例如 Google 有個很棒的網站，叫 Teachable Machine。

cues.en: And as you can see, what it does is, well, it helps you do some machine learning activities.
cues.zh: 它會協助你進行機器學習活動。

cues.en: So if I click on Get Started Here, and by the way, by the time you watch the video, maybe they've changed the layout of this website.
cues.zh: 點 Get Started；順帶一提，你看影片時，網站版面也許已經不同。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter because this is more for you to kind of understand how things work underneath the hood and even play with this yourself.
cues.zh: 沒關係，重點是大致了解背後如何運作，也能親自嘗試。

cues.en: So let's create an image project.
cues.zh: 建立 Image Project。

cues.en: And for now, all we're going to do is say, hey, I want to decide or create a machine learning model that detects faces or cats.
cues.zh: 目前只想建立能辨識人臉或貓的機器學習模型。

cues.en: So let's just say this is going to be faces and this is going to be cats.
cues.zh: 這個類別設為 faces，另一個設為 cats。

cues.en: And we have to give it some image samples so that the machine can learn, right?
cues.zh: 要提供影像樣本，機器才能學習，對吧？

cues.en: So in here on my desktop, I've actually saved a couple of photos.
cues.zh: 桌面上已經存了幾張照片。

cues.en: I found a nice little cute cat picture online.
cues.zh: 我在網路找到一張可愛小貓照片。

cues.en: So let's upload the cat picture.
cues.zh: 先上傳貓的照片。

cues.en: So we'll upload the cat picture here.
cues.zh: 在這裡上傳。

cues.en: You can see that we're only uploading one.
cues.zh: 可以看到，只上傳一張。

cues.en: And here I will upload the faces picture.
cues.zh: 再上傳人臉照片。

cues.en: We'll upload the baby's picture here.
cues.zh: 這裡上傳嬰兒照片。

cues.en: So we have faces and cats and then we train our model.
cues.zh: 現在有 faces 和 cats，接著訓練模型。

cues.en: We essentially tell the computer, Hey, this is an example of what a face looks like and this is an example of what a cat looks like.
cues.zh: 基本上是告訴電腦：「這是人臉的範例，這是貓的範例。」

cues.en: So just learn, please.
cues.zh: 「請學習。」

cues.en: So you can see over here it's learning.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到正在學習。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 完成了。

cues.en: It now has created a model.
cues.zh: 現在已建立模型。

cues.en: Now in here, I can use my webcam or I can just upload a file.
cues.zh: 這裡可以用網路攝影機，也可以上傳檔案。

cues.en: So let's just upload.
cues.zh: 先上傳。

cues.en: A snorkel picture that I have of myself and I click open.
cues.zh: 一張我浮潛的照片，點 Open。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: This model that we trained thinks that this has a 49% chance.
cues.zh: 訓練出的模型認為，這張有 49% 的機率。

cues.en: Let's make this a little bit bigger.
cues.zh: 放大一點。

cues.en: This has a 49% chance that this image is a face and a 51% chance that I'm a cat.
cues.zh: 它認為影像有 49% 機率是人臉，51% 機率我是貓。

cues.en: Hmm.
cues.zh: 嗯。

cues.en: What's going on here?
cues.zh: 怎麼回事？

cues.en: What if we give it a better picture?
cues.zh: 換張好一點的照片呢？

cues.en: I mean, this is a tough picture, right?
cues.zh: 這張確實不好判斷，對吧？

cues.en: It's a little bit fuzzy.
cues.zh: 有點模糊。

cues.en: I have my snorkeling mask on.
cues.zh: 又戴著浮潛面鏡。

cues.en: Maybe it's a tough picture for this model to predict.
cues.zh: 模型也許很難預測。

cues.en: So I'm going to upload a different file, let's say this exact same face that I use in the image if I click open.
cues.zh: 再上傳別的檔案，例如和原本影像相同的人臉，點 Open。

cues.en: Oh, boy.
cues.zh: 喔。

cues.en: That's even worse.
cues.zh: 更糟了。

cues.en: It thinks I'm 57% cat and it's 43% certain that this is a face.
cues.zh: 它認為我有 57% 是貓，43% 確定是人臉。

cues.en: What's happening here?
cues.zh: 怎麼回事？

cues.en: Well, what you've just witnessed is how machine learning works.
cues.zh: 剛才看到的，就是機器學習的運作方式。

cues.en: We provide the computer some data.
cues.zh: 先提供電腦資料。

cues.en: In this case, I provided one image of myself and Daniel's face and one picture of a cat.
cues.zh: 這裡提供一張我和 Daniel 的人臉影像，以及一張貓照片。

cues.en: Based on those two inputs and data, I say, Hey, computer, learn.
cues.zh: 根據這兩個輸入資料，告訴電腦：「請學習。」

cues.en: Try to understand this picture and try to understand this picture.
cues.zh: 試著理解這張照片，也理解另一張。

cues.en: And next time I give you any images based on this data, predict for me or tell me how much confidence you have that either it's a cat or a face.
cues.zh: 下次根據這些資料，給你新的影像時，請預測或告訴我，有多大把握它是貓或人臉。

cues.en: And that's pretty much machine learning.
cues.zh: 機器學習大致就是如此。

cues.en: It doesn't have to be just images.
cues.zh: 不一定是影像。

cues.en: It just needs to be some sort of data.
cues.zh: 只要是某種資料。

cues.en: We train the computer and we create a model that can predict for us based on that data.
cues.zh: 訓練電腦，建立能根據資料預測的模型。

cues.en: Now we see here that it's really, really bad.
cues.zh: 但這裡效果很差。

cues.en: I mean, this is definitely not a cat.
cues.zh: 這明明不是貓。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So why is it bad?
cues.zh: 為什麼很差？

cues.en: Well, think about this for a second.
cues.zh: 想一想。

cues.en: Try to answer it on your own.
cues.zh: 先試著自己回答。

cues.en: Ready for the answer?
cues.zh: 準備好聽答案了嗎？

cues.en: Well, number one is that we've only given it one image each.
cues.zh: 第一，每類只給了一張影像。

cues.en: For a computer to really learn and to understand what a faces, what a cat is.
cues.zh: 電腦要真正學會並理解人臉或貓，

cues.en: It needs hundreds, thousands, if not millions of images of cats to detect patterns to figure out, Hey, this is what a cat is.
cues.zh: 需要數百、數千，甚至數百萬張貓影像，才能偵測模式，明白貓是什麼。

cues.en: Hey, this is what I face is right now.
cues.zh: 也明白人臉是什麼；目前，

cues.en: I've only given it one sample each.
cues.zh: 每類只提供一個樣本。

cues.en: So this model is not very smart.
cues.zh: 所以模型不太聰明。

cues.en: Just like a human right to learn something in school, you have to repeat it.
cues.zh: 就像人類在學校學習，需要反覆練習。

cues.en: You have to see it over and over.
cues.zh: 必須一次又一次看到。

cues.en: And then also with the preview, sometimes I give it a really clear image of a face, or sometimes I give it the snorkeling picture.
cues.zh: 另外，在 Preview，有時提供清楚人臉，有時給浮潛照片。

cues.en: That's really fuzzy.
cues.zh: 那張很模糊。

cues.en: So that also affects the output.
cues.zh: 也會影響輸出。

cues.en: But at the end of the day, machine learning is just that.
cues.zh: 但機器學習基本上就是這樣。

cues.en: We give it some input and then we tell the machine to learn based on those inputs and give us an output next time we give it a new input.
cues.zh: 先給輸入，讓機器根據輸入學習，下次給新輸入時，產生輸出。

cues.en: Now.
cues.zh: 現在，

cues.en: I want you to take a break here.
cues.zh: 在這裡先休息一下。

cues.en: I'm going to link to this resource so that you can actually play with this yourself and see if you can improve this model.
cues.zh: 我會提供資源連結，讓你自己操作，看看能不能改善模型。

cues.en: You can even have your webcam on.
cues.zh: 也可以開啟網路攝影機。

cues.en: So instead of a file, you have your webcam just like in the examples that they provide.
cues.zh: 不用檔案，像網站範例一樣，用攝影機。

cues.en: So if I go to teachable machine.
cues.zh: 到 Teachable Machine。

cues.en: You can see here different projects that you can build just by clicking without programming anything.
cues.zh: 這裡能看到不同專案，只要點選就能建立，不必寫程式。

cues.en: You can even export your model once you're done so that you can use it in your own projects.
cues.zh: 完成後甚至可以匯出模型，用到自己的專案。

cues.en: Again, if this is confusing, don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果還不理解，不用擔心。

cues.en: We're actually going to go step by step.
cues.zh: 之後會逐步教。

cues.en: And instead of just doing something visually, we're actually going to code and learn how machine learning and data scientists work.
cues.zh: 不只是操作視覺介面，還會寫程式，了解機器學習與資料科學家的工作。

cues.en: But this is a great way for you to just understand on high level how machine learning works.
cues.zh: 但這是初步了解機器學習運作的好方式。

cues.en: So go off and play with this website and I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 去玩玩這個網站，下一支影片見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
